_about: Image slots for the cmd site. Generate each image from its prompt at the given dimensions, save it to assets/generated/. It then appears on the page automatically — each slot's already points at this path, and an on-brand SVG line-art fallback shows until the file exists. No code edit needed; just drop the files in and reload.
_style: Pure black background. A single galaxy-violet accent only (#9B7BFF / #C8A8FF) — no other colours. No readable text or logos. Photorealistic / cinematic, subtle film grain. Must match cmd-brand.md section 10 (astrophotography, no stock cliché, no rocket-emoji kitsch).
_placement:
Each slot is a
in index.html containing plus the same prompt inline as an HTML comment.

slots.alt: A smartphone in space with a faded desktop screen condensing into it
slots.prompt: A single sleek smartphone floating upright in deep black space, its screen glowing with a faint violet minimal website; behind it a larger faded desktop screen condensing/dissolving into the phone to suggest mobile-first design. Pure black background, one lilac accent (#C8A8FF) and nothing else. Photorealistic 3D render, soft studio light, subtle film grain, no readable text.

slots.alt: A violet light streak racing across black, conveying instant speed
slots.prompt: A glowing violet light-streak / comet tearing across pure black space, conveying instant speed and a site that loads in a blink; long motion-blur trail. Monochrome black with a single galaxy-violet accent (#9B7BFF), nothing else. Cinematic, photorealistic, no readable text.

slots.alt: A smartphone with violet call rings radiating outward against black
slots.prompt: A smartphone on pure black space with concentric violet call/sound rings radiating outward and a small glowing 'incoming call' violet dot, conveying the phone ringing with new leads. One galaxy-violet accent (#9B7BFF), the rest monochrome. Photorealistic 3D render, soft glow, subtle grain, no readable text.

slots.alt: Glowing violet wireframe blueprint of a website floating in space
slots.prompt: A glowing violet holographic wireframe blueprint of a website page floating in deep black space — thin luminous lilac lines forming a browser/page layout like a hologram schematic, with a faint dark grid behind it. Pure black background, a single galaxy-violet accent (#9B7BFF / #C8A8FF) and nothing else. Cinematic, photorealistic holographic render, soft glow, subtle film grain, no readable text.

slots.alt: Small dark planet with a single satellite on an orbital ring against black
slots.prompt: A small dark terrestrial planet against pure black space with a faint violet rim-light along one edge and a single tiny satellite on a thin orbital ring around it; a calm, always-live feeling. Telescope-style astrophotography, monochrome with one lilac accent (#C8A8FF), photorealistic, subtle grain. No rings-clipart, no readable text.

slots.alt: A rocket launching through space with a violet exhaust trail
slots.prompt: A sleek rocket launching upward through deep black space, leaving a glowing violet exhaust trail and a faint violet rim-light along its body; a sense of liftoff and momentum. Pure black background, a single galaxy-violet accent (#9B7BFF / #C8A8FF) and nothing else. Cinematic, photorealistic 3D render, subtle film grain, no readable text.
